project.name: action_recognition
project.purpose: Crowd action/violence recognition using RGB + flow + crowd-density multi-modal fusion

high_level_architecture.crowd_branch: FasterRCNN person detections -> density maps + lightweight 3D encoder

data_layout_contract.class_resolution: Dynamic from labels/folders; no fixed class list required

gpu_memory_controls.note: Reduces OOM likelihood but cannot guarantee strict hard-limit behavior due to allocator/runtime details.

git_hygiene.policy: Repository intended to exclude large data/model artifacts.

major_changes_made_in_session: Converted class handling to dynamic label inference.
Added full pipeline script (manifest -> precompute -> train).
Added per-run artifact persistence under runs/<timestamp>/.
Added training tqdm progress and metric/summary saving.
Added memory/OOM mitigation settings for CUDA training.
Added standalone video inference script (test.py) and shell wrapper.
Expanded README with architecture, workflow, results template, and AI provenance.
Added dataset bootstrap script (data.py) and updated .gitignore.
known_operational_notes: Use conda env 'video-act' in this workspace.
Precompute stage can be expensive; cached aux files significantly reduce repeated run time.
run_training.py now resolves absolute project paths to avoid writing artifacts outside repo.
If classes change across datasets, ensure checkpoint and class names are from the same run.
recommended_resume_prompt_template: Load SESSION_CONTEXT.json and summarize current architecture, run commands, and pending TODOs. Then continue from the latest run under runs/<timestamp>.
pending_todos: Optionally add plotting utility for metrics.csv -> curves image.
Optionally add confusion matrix generation script and export to assets/results/.
